title.zh: 感恩节前美股期货下跌，关税报道引发关注
title.en: US equity futures fall ahead of Thanksgiving as tariff reports draw attention

summary.en: US equity futures were lower ahead of Thanksgiving as investors assessed reports of possible new US tariffs. October PCE inflation rose 3.8% year over year, third-quarter real GDP growth was revised to 4.3% annualized, and initial jobless claims fell to 189,000.
summary.zh: 感恩节前美股期货走低，市场关注美国可能加征关税的报道。10月PCE物价指数同比上涨3.8%，三季度实际GDP增速上修至年化4.3%，初请失业金人数降至18.9万。

title.zh: 英伟达带动周一大涨后，纳指100期货盘前领跌
title.en: Nasdaq-100 futures lead declines after Monday's Nvidia rally

summary.en: At 08:54 ET, Nasdaq-100 futures fell 2.05%, S&P 500 futures 1.23% and Dow futures 0.60% from their respective Monday 16:00 ET readings. Monday's cash session had ended with the S&P 500 up 4.60% and the Nasdaq Composite up 6.36%. The 10-year yield and dollar were lower this morning. The Philadelphia Fed's regional nonmanufacturing index improved but stayed negative, and Analog Devices reported record fiscal fourth-quarter revenue. Tuesday's consumer confidence data and Wednesday's PCE inflation report are the next major tests.
summary.zh: 美东时间08:54，纳指100、标普500及道指期货较各自周一16:00的参考值分别下跌2.05%、1.23%和0.60%。周一现货收盘时，标普500上涨4.60%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨6.36%。今早10年期美债收益率和美元走低。费城联储非制造业调查的地区活动指数回升但仍为负值，亚德诺公布创纪录的财年第四季度营收。接下来关注周二消费者信心和周三PCE通胀数据。

title.zh: 周五美股大跌，假日消费成为本周焦点
title.en: Friday's selloff puts holiday spending in focus

summary.en: U.S. index futures rose before Monday's open following a sharp selloff in Friday's cash session. The Chicago Fed's October activity index fell to -0.06 from September's revised +0.05, pointing to growth slightly below trend. Investors will watch Wednesday's October PCE and second estimate of third-quarter GDP, along with holiday-season consumer spending.
summary.zh: 周五美股现货大跌后，周一主要股指期货在开盘前回升。芝加哥联储10月全国活动指数由9月修正后的+0.05降至-0.06，显示经济增速略低于趋势。市场关注周三公布的10月PCE和三季度GDP第二次估算，以及假日购物季的实际消费表现。

title.zh: 标普500连续六个交易日下跌，假日消费成为市场焦点
title.en: S&P 500 extends losing streak to six sessions as holiday spending comes into focus

summary.en: As of 09:00 EST, equity futures were lower versus their own Thursday 16:00 EST readings, with S&P 500 futures down 0.85%, Nasdaq-100 futures down 1.61% and Dow futures down 0.28%. That follows a sixth straight cash-session loss for the S&P 500, which closed down 1.98% Thursday and dropped below its 200-day average this week. The 10-year Treasury yield and the U.S. Dollar Index eased, Ross Stores raised full-year EPS guidance, and the November Michigan consumer sentiment reading was scheduled for 10:00 EST.
summary.zh: 截至美东时间09:00，三大股指期货较各自周四16:00的报价均下跌，标普500期货跌0.85%，纳指100期货跌1.61%，道指期货跌0.28%。标普500现货指数周四收跌1.98%，连续第六个交易日下跌，本周跌破200日均线。10年期美债收益率和美元指数走低，Ross Stores上调全年每股收益指引，密歇根大学11月消费者信心终值定于美东时间10:00发布。

title.zh: 周三回顾：股指收盘分化，零售股走强
title.en: Wednesday recap: indexes finish mixed while retailers advance

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures are up 0.97% and 1.71% versus the prior cash-close reference after Wednesday's mixed session. Official initial jobless claims rose to 203,000 from a revised 202,000. Wednesday's minutes discussion keeps rate risk in focus; the 10-year yield is 5.085%. Palo Alto Networks' fiscal Q1 report came after its 9.9% regular-session gain, and the dollar is slightly lower while oil rebounds.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周三涨跌互现后，标普500和纳指100期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值涨0.97%、1.71%。官方初请失业金人数增至203,000人，前周修正为202,000人。周三会议纪要讨论使利率风险仍受关注，10年期收益率为5.085%。PANW第一财季报告在其常规交易涨9.9%之后公布；美元微跌，原油反弹。

title.zh: 英伟达公布第三财季业绩，上调2028财年营收增长展望
title.en: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 results and raises fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: Nasdaq-100 and S&P 500 futures are up 0.81% and 0.36% versus the prior cash-close reference following Nvidia's results and higher fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook. October housing starts rose 9.9% monthly while permits fell 7.4%. The dollar is firmer, oil and gold futures are lower, and the Fed's October minutes remain scheduled for 14:00 EST. Anthropic's expected pricing is still unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：英伟达公布财报并上调2028财年营收增长展望后，纳指100和标普500期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值涨0.81%、0.36%。已公布的10月新屋开工环比增9.9%，许可降7.4%。美元走强，原油和黄金期货走低；美联储10月会议纪要仍待14:00 EST公布，Anthropic预期发行定价尚未确认。

title.zh: 美国10月零售与餐饮销售环比增0.2%
title.en: October retail and food-services sales rise 0.2% month over month

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: US futures are mixed after Monday's selloff, with Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.23% and S&P 500 futures down 0.20% versus the previous cash-close reference. October retail sales rose 0.2% month over month; import and export prices each rose 1.1%. Nvidia's results remain due after the close. Higher Treasury yields and oil prices complicate the attempted technology recovery.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周一抛售后，美股期货涨跌互现，纳指100和标普500期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值分别上涨0.23%、下跌0.20%。已公布的10月零售销售环比增0.2%，进口、出口价格均环比涨1.1%。英伟达财报仍待盘后发布，美债收益率与油价走高增加科技板块修复的不确定性。

title.zh: 上周回顾：美股周线走高，通胀与利率压力仍在
title.en: Prior-week recap: US stocks advanced despite inflation and rate pressure

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: US futures are lower relative to Friday's cash-close reference, led by Nasdaq-100 futures at -1.38%; S&P 500 futures are down 0.69%. The 10-year Treasury yield eases to 5.133%, while the dollar edges higher and crude declines. This week brings Nvidia's Tuesday results, Anthropic's planned IPO and a Monday speech by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：美股期货较周五美股常规收盘时的参考值下跌，纳指100期货跌1.38%、标普500期货跌0.69%。10年期美债收益率回落至5.133%，美元小幅走强，原油下跌。本周关注英伟达周二财报、Anthropic拟议IPO，以及美联储主席Kevin Warsh周一讲话。

title.zh: 美国10月PPI环比上涨0.3%、同比上涨6.5%
title.en: October PPI rises 0.3% month over month and 6.5% year over year

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: US futures attempt a modest recovery after Thursday's decline, with S&P 500 futures up 0.42% and Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.20% versus the previous cash close. October PPI rose 0.3% month over month and 6.5% year over year; the measure excluding food, energy and trade services rose 0.5%. Treasury yields remain elevated as next week's AI catalysts approach.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周四美股下跌后，标普500和纳斯达克100期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值分别上涨0.42%和0.20%，呈现温和修复。10月PPI环比上涨0.3%、同比上涨6.5%；剔除食品、能源和贸易服务的指标环比上涨0.5%。美债收益率仍处高位，下周AI相关重要事件临近。

title.zh: CoreWeave业绩及合同关联融资计划支持周三半导体板块上涨
title.en: CoreWeave results and contract-linked financing support Wednesday's semiconductor rally

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: Wednesday's AI-led advance faces a weaker opening setup, with S&P 500 futures down 0.68% and Nasdaq-100 futures down 1.30% versus the previous US cash close. Initial jobless claims rose to 200,000, above the 195,000 consensus, while Treasury yields stand at 5.048%. The key question is whether semiconductor strength can persist under rate pressure.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周三AI板块带动的上涨面临偏弱的开盘环境，标普500和纳斯达克100期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值分别下跌0.68%和1.30%。初请失业金人数升至20万人，高于19.5万人的市场预期；10年期美债收益率为5.048%。关注半导体强势能否在利率压力下延续。

title.zh: 高盛在10月通胀数据公布后，将3月加息25个基点纳入美联储展望
title.en: Goldman adds a March 25bp Fed hike to its outlook after October inflation data

summary.en: US equities face a tech-led recovery attempt after Tuesday's losses. CoreWeave reported revenue growth of 168% and a path to profitability in H1 2028, while Goldman Sachs added a March 25bp Fed hike to its outlook after the October inflation report. Nasdaq-100 futures are up 1.94% and S&P 500 futures 0.98% versus the previous US cash close, but a 0.52% stronger dollar highlights the tension between AI optimism and tighter policy expectations. US stock markets are open on Veterans Day; the 4.983% Treasury yield is a previous bond-session reference during the fixed-income holiday.
summary.zh: 美股在周二下跌后迎来科技股带动的修复尝试。CoreWeave报告营收增长168%，并给出2028年上半年实现盈利的展望；高盛则在10月通胀数据公布后，将3月加息25个基点纳入美联储利率展望。纳斯达克100期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值上涨1.94%，标普500期货上涨0.98%，但美元指数走强0.52%，显示AI乐观预期与政策收紧预期之间仍有拉锯。退伍军人节当天美股照常交易；债市假日期间，4.983%的美债收益率仅作为前一债市交易日参考。

title.zh: 美国 CPI 十月上涨 0.4%，增强十二月加息概率
title.en: US CPI rises 0.4% in October, strengthening December rate hike odds

summary.en: October inflation data exceeded expectations, reinforcing Federal Reserve rate hike expectations for December. S&P 500 futures declined sharply while Dow E-minis edged higher in premarket trading. Treasury yields and the dollar index rose alongside the hotter-than-expected consumer price report.
summary.zh: 十月通胀数据超出预期，强化了美联储十二月加息的预期。标普 500 期货大幅下跌，而道指 E-mini 期货在盘前交易中小幅上涨。美债收益率和美元指数随通胀报告超预期而上升。

title.zh: 纳指因中期选举后AI板块抛售跌入修正区间；10月CPI周二公布，检验约80%的12月加息概率
title.en: Nasdaq in correction after post-midterm AI selloff; October CPI due Tuesday tests ~80% December rate-hike odds

summary.en: US equities face a week of key technology earnings, including CoreWeave, and Tuesday's October CPI release on a fragile footing after the Nasdaq slid into correction territory amid post-midterm AI data-center regulatory concerns. Premarket futures point to a modest broad-based rebound following Friday's tech-led recovery, but the roughly 80% market-implied probability of a December Fed rate hike and firm core-services inflation expectations remain headwinds. The key test is whether CoreWeave's project-financing commentary and Tuesday's CPI print can stabilize the AI trade or trigger renewed selling.
summary.zh: 纳指在中期选举后的AI数据中心监管忧虑中跌入回调区间，美股以脆弱态势迎来包括CoreWeave在内的本周科技公司财报，以及周二公布的10月CPI。周五科技股领涨反弹后，盘前股指期货显示市场可能普遍小幅反弹，但市场隐含的12月美联储加息概率约80%，叠加核心服务通胀偏强预期，仍构成阻力。关键考验在于CoreWeave的项目融资评论和周二CPI数据能否稳定AI交易，还是引发新一轮抛售。

title.zh: 亚洲股市因数据中心政策担忧大幅下跌；日经225跌6%，KOSPI跌6%，MSCI亚太跌3.9%
title.en: Asian markets fall sharply on data-center policy concerns; Nikkei -6%, KOSPI -6%, MSCI APAC -3.9%

summary.en: Asian equity markets fell sharply on Friday as traders priced in potential data-center spending constraints from new state-level political leadership, with the Nikkei 225 down 6% and South Korea's KOSPI down 6%. The BLS reported October nonfarm payrolls rose 165,000—well above the 48,000 twelve-month average—with the unemployment rate at 4.1% and average hourly earnings up 0.4% month over month to $38.00. US equity futures point modestly higher this morning (NQ +1.53%, ES +0.18%) after Thursday's broad selloff, while the 10-year Treasury yield ticked up 3.1 basis points to 4.868%.
summary.zh: 周五亚洲股市大幅下跌，交易员担忧新任州级政治领导层可能限制数据中心支出，日经225指数下跌6%，韩国KOSPI指数下跌6%。美国劳工统计局报告10月非农就业新增16.5万，远高于12个月均值4.8万，失业率变化不大，为4.1%，平均时薪环比上涨0.4%至$38.00。周四美股大幅下跌后，今晨美股期货小幅走高（NQ +1.53%，ES +0.18%），10年期美债收益率上行3.1个基点至4.868%。

title.zh: Disc Medicine：bitopertin治疗EPP的III期APOLLO试验达到全部主要和次要终点；10月$486M增发后Q3末现金约$683M
title.en: Disc Medicine: Phase 3 APOLLO trial of bitopertin in EPP meets all primary and secondary endpoints; Q3 cash ~$683M after $486M October offering

summary.en: Disc Medicine reported that its Phase 3 APOLLO trial of bitopertin in erythropoietic protoporphyria met all primary and secondary endpoints, with a 41.4% reduction in whole-blood metal-free PPIX versus placebo, and ended Q3 with approximately $683M in cash after a $486M October offering. Dogwood Therapeutics completed its Halneuron Phase 2b CINP trial (239 patients) with top-line results expected in November and closed a $5M private placement extending its runway to Q1 2027. Premarket futures show a mixed picture: S&P 500 futures are flat at +0.09% while Nasdaq-100 futures are down 0.81%, suggesting the prior session's broad rally is not being extended.
summary.zh: Disc Medicine（NASDAQ: IRON）报告其bitopertin治疗红细胞生成性原卟啉症的III期APOLLO试验达到全部主要和次要终点，全血无金属PPIX较安慰剂降低41.4%，第三季度末现金约$683M（含10月$486M增发）。Dogwood Therapeutics（Nasdaq: DWTX）完成Halneuron IIb期CINP试验（239例），预计 11 月公布首批主要结果。公司完成 500 万美元私募融资，资金可支撑运营至 2027 年第一季度。盘前期货表现分化：标普500期货持平（+0.09%），纳指100期货下跌0.81%，前一交易日的普涨格局未见延续。

title.zh: Sofwave Medical（TASE: SOFW）公布2026年第三季度营收$28.5M（同比+35%），IFRS净利润$4.1M，并获得中国NMPA批准进入大陆市场
title.en: Sofwave Medical (TASE: SOFW) Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $28.5M (+35% YoY), IFRS Net Income of $4.1M, and NMPA Approval for Mainland China

summary.en: Sofwave Medical (TASE: SOFW) reported Q3 revenue of $28.5M (+35% YoY) with IFRS net income of $4.1M and announced NMPA approval for mainland China. Fusemachines (Nasdaq: FUSE) posted Q3 revenue of $1.85M (+2.8% QoQ) with a 39.2% QoQ improvement in non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA loss, though a going-concern doubt remains. KeyCorp (NYSE: KEY) announced a definitive agreement to acquire Atlantic-Pacific Capital, expected to close early 2027. Premarket, Nasdaq futures are up 0.71% after the prior session's 1.06% Nasdaq decline, while the 10-year Treasury yield ticked up 0.4 bp to 4.898% and WTI eased 1.48% to $94.45.
summary.zh: Sofwave Medical（TASE: SOFW）公布第三季度营收$28.5M（同比+35%），IFRS净利润$4.1M，并宣布获得中国NMPA批准进入大陆市场。Fusemachines（Nasdaq: FUSE）第三季度营收$1.85M（环比+2.8%），非GAAP调整后EBITDA亏损环比改善39.2%，但财务报表仍披露持续经营疑虑。KeyCorp（NYSE: KEY）宣布与Atlantic-Pacific Capital达成收购协议，预计2027年初完成交割。盘前纳斯达克期货上涨0.71%，此前一个交易日纳斯达克综合指数下跌1.06%；10年期美债收益率微升0.4个基点至4.898%，WTI原油回落1.48%至$94.45。

title.zh: IDEXX第三季度营收$1,214M（增长10%）、EPS $4.01；全年营收指引上调至$4,741M–$4,767M
title.en: IDEXX Q3 revenue $1,214M (+10%) and EPS $4.01; raises 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741M–$4,767M

summary.en: Information cutoff: 09:00 EST. IDEXX reported Q3 revenue of $1,214M (+10% reported and organic), raising 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741M–$4,767M and EPS guidance to $14.96–$15.16. Pathfinder reported Q3 diluted EPS of $0.32, versus $0.42 in Q2 and $0.10 a year earlier.
summary.zh: 信息截至09:00 EST。IDEXX 第三季度营收 12.14 亿美元，按披露口径和有机口径均增长 10%；2026 年营收指引上调至 47.41 亿至 47.67 亿美元，每股收益指引上调至 14.96 至 15.16 美元。Pathfinder第三季度稀释EPS为$0.32，上季为$0.42、去年同期为$0.10。

title.zh: 亚马逊跌 7%，英特尔暴跌 25%，财报遭投资者失望
title.en: Amazon Falls 7%, Intel Plunges 25% After Earnings Disappointment

summary.en: US stocks face pressure ahead of opening as Amazon and Intel miss earnings expectations, dragging Nasdaq futures down 2%. The crypto sector faces additional headwinds after Binance suffered a historic $6.3 billion hack. Oil prices firm up on Middle East tensions while treasury yields decline amid mixed economic data outlook.
summary.zh: 美股盘前承压，Amazon 和 Intel 财报不及预期拖累纳指期货下跌 2%。加密板块受 Binance 遭创纪录 63 亿美元黑客攻击影响进一步承压。油价因中东紧张局势走强，美债收益率在经济数据展望混杂中下跌。
